name: Topological Voxelization with Intersection Targets
definition: A voxelization method where a voxel V is included in the output set S_d if and only if the input primitives intersect a specific geometric 'intersection target' contained within V. This approach relies on topological connectivity and separability properties rather than geometric proximity measures.
summary: Topological Voxelization with Intersection Targets determines intersected voxels by testing primitives against specific geometric targets, guaranteeing topological connectivity and separability independent of input tessellation.
